AddMemories.description_en: Writes messages or text to a memory store. If sync is omitted or set to true, the operation synchronously waits for extraction and returns only memories, which can be an empty array. If sync is set to false, the operation returns only a taskId, and you can query the result by calling GetMemoryTask
AddMemories.description_zh: 向记忆空间写入消息或文本。sync 缺省为 true，同步等待抽取并仅返回 memories（允许空数组）；sync=false 仅返回 taskId，通过 GetMemoryTask 查询

BatchDeleteModels.description_en: Deletes multiple models in a specified workspace. If any model is in use, the entire batch request fails
BatchDeleteModels.description_zh: 批量删除指定工作空间中的模型；任一模型正在被使用时，整批请求失败

BatchUploadSkillsViaOss.description_en: Uploads multiple skill ZIP packages through OSS and returns the processing result for each skill
BatchUploadSkillsViaOss.description_zh: 通过 OSS 中转批量上传 Skill ZIP 包，并返回每个 Skill 的处理结果

ConvertMcpToFreeEdit.description_en: Converts an MCP server to free-edit mode
ConvertMcpToFreeEdit.description_zh: 将 MCP 转为自由编辑

CreateAgentIMChannel.description_en: Creates an IM channel for a specified agent and binds it to a publicly accessible service endpoint
CreateAgentIMChannel.description_zh: 为指定智能体创建 IM 渠道，并绑定可公开访问的 ServiceEndpoint

CreateAgentSpec.description_en: Creates an AgentSpec in a specified workspace and generates the first draft version. Returns a resource conflict error if an AgentSpec with the same name already exists
CreateAgentSpec.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建 AgentSpec，并生成首个草稿版本。同名 AgentSpec 已存在时返回资源冲突错误

CreateAgentSpecVersion.description_en: Creates a new draft version for an existing AgentSpec. The AgentSpec must exist and must not have a draft currently being edited
CreateAgentSpecVersion.description_zh: 为已有 AgentSpec 创建新的草稿版本。AgentSpec 必须存在，且当前不能有正在编辑的草稿

CreateCredential.description_en: Creates an apiKey or mcpHeader credential in a workspace for agents or MCP to access external services. The credential content is submitted as a JSON string, and masked results are returned when queried
CreateCredential.description_zh: 在工作空间中创建 apiKey 或 mcpHeader 凭证，供智能体或 MCP 访问外部服务。凭证内容使用 JSON 字符串提交，查询时返回脱敏结果

CreateCustomAgent.description_en: Creates a custom code or image agent in a specified workspace, supports code package, ACR image, and custom image deployments, and executes the deployment asynchronously
CreateCustomAgent.description_zh: 在指定工作空间创建自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent，支持代码包、ACR 镜像和自定义镜像部署，并异步执行部署

CreateExternalAgent.description_en: Creates an agent that runs in an external environment, saves the configurations for the platform model, instructions, tools, and skills, and asynchronously processes the bootstrap configuration
CreateExternalAgent.description_zh: 创建由外部环境运行的智能体，保存平台模型、指令、工具和技能配置，并异步处理接入配置

CreateExternalAgentBootstrapToken.description_en: Issues an access token for a specified network to a managed agent with effective configurations and returns the CMS configuration
CreateExternalAgentBootstrapToken.description_zh: 为已生效的纳管 Agent签发指定网络的接入令牌，并返回 CMS 配置

CreateIdentityProvider.description_en: Binds an external identity provider such as DingTalk, Lark, or a custom identity source to a workspace for enterprise account logon and user synchronization
CreateIdentityProvider.description_zh: 为工作空间接入钉钉、飞书或自定义身份源，用于企业账号登录和用户同步

CreateIdentityProviderSCIMCredential.description_en: Explicitly issues a SCIM credential and returns the plaintext token only in the current response. A maximum of two credentials can exist in the same pool. This operation does not automatically revoke old credentials or enable AC user synchronization
CreateIdentityProviderSCIMCredential.description_zh: 显式签发一枚 SCIM 凭据并仅当次返回 Token 明文。同池最多两枚，不自动撤销旧凭据或开启 AC 用户同步

CreateIdentityProviderSyncJob.description_en: Initiates a manual synchronization for an identity provider

CreateImageCache.description_en: Creates or reuses a cache for an ACR Enterprise Edition image in a workspace, and returns the cache status upon acceptance
CreateImageCache.description_zh: 为工作空间的 ACR 企业版镜像创建或复用缓存，并返回受理时的缓存状态

CreateManagedAgent.description_en: Creates a managed Harness agent in a specified workspace, configures the harness, model, skills, and runtime resources, and deploys the agent asynchronously
CreateManagedAgent.description_zh: 在指定工作空间创建托管 Harness Agent，配置 Harness、模型、技能及运行资源，并异步部署

CreateMcp.description_en: Creates an MCP service in a specified workspace. The creation process is asynchronous. You can check whether the service is ready by using the returned status or a query operation
CreateMcp.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建 MCP 服务。创建为异步过程，可通过返回的状态或查询接口确认服务是否就绪

CreateMemoryStore.description_en: Creates a long-term memory store in a specified workspace
CreateMemoryStore.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建长期记忆库

CreateModel.description_en: Creates a model configuration under a model connection in a specified workspace for model creation
CreateModel.description_zh: 在指定工作空间的模型连接下创建模型配置

CreateModelConnection.description_en: Creates a model connection in a specified workspace and configures the upstream model service address, invoke protocol, and access credentials for model creation
CreateModelConnection.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建模型连接，并配置上游模型服务地址、调用协议和访问凭据

CreateSkillDraft.description_en: Creates a skill in a specified workspace and generates an editable draft version. You can derive the draft from an existing version, or specify a target version and a commit message
CreateSkillDraft.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建 Skill，并生成可继续编辑的草稿版本。可以基于已有版本派生草稿，也可以指定目标版本和提交说明

CreateTeam.description_en: Creates a team in a specified workspace and configures user members and agent members at the same time. Exactly one user member must have the ADMIN role, and agent members can only have the LEADER or WORKER role
CreateTeam.description_zh: 在指定工作空间内创建团队，并同时设置用户成员和智能体成员。用户成员中必须且只能有一个角色为 ADMIN 的成员，智能体成员的角色只能是 LEADER 或 WORKER

CreateUser.description_en: Creates a user in a specified workspace. The username must be unique within the workspace, can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, and cannot be a reserved name such as manager, admin, or any name starting with worker-. If the password is not specified, the server generates an initial password and returns it in the initialPassword field of the response
CreateUser.description_zh: 在指定工作空间内创建用户。用户名称在工作空间内唯一，只能包含小写字母、数字和连字符，并且不能使用 manager、admin 或以 worker- 开头的保留名称。不指定 password 时由服务端生成初始密码，并通过响应中的 initialPassword 返回

CreateWorkspace.description_en: Creates an AgentCore workspace as a resource scope for organizing agents, models, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services, and collaboration configurations
CreateWorkspace.description_zh: 创建 AgentCore 工作空间，作为组织 Agent、模型、MCP 服务和协作配置的资源范围

DebugModel.description_en: Invokes a specified model through a published model connection to verify whether the model invocation pipeline is available
DebugModel.description_zh: 通过已发布的模型连接调用指定模型，用于验证模型调用链路是否可用

DeleteAgentIMChannel.description_en: Deletes the IM channel of a specified agent
DeleteAgentIMChannel.description_zh: 删除指定智能体的 IM 渠道

DeleteAgentSpec.description_en: Deletes the specified AgentSpec and all its versions and metadata. This operation is irreversible
DeleteAgentSpec.description_zh: 删除指定 AgentSpec 及其全部版本和元数据。删除操作不可恢复

DeleteAgentSpecVersion.description_en: Deletes the draft version of the specified AgentSpec that is currently being edited and clears the draft version pointer
DeleteAgentSpecVersion.description_zh: 删除指定 AgentSpec 当前正在编辑的草稿版本，并清除草稿版本指针

DeleteCredential.description_en: Deletes a credential in a specified workspace and deletes the ciphertext hosted in the credential service. After deletion, agents bound to the credential can no longer obtain the credential content
DeleteCredential.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间内的凭证，同时删除托管在凭证服务中的密文。删除后已绑定该凭证的智能体将无法再获取凭证内容

DeleteCustomAgent.description_en: Deletes a custom code or image agent in a specified workspace and asynchronously cleans up its associated platform resources
DeleteCustomAgent.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent，并异步清理其平台关联资源

DeleteExternalAgent.description_en: Deletes a managed agent in a specified workspace and asynchronously cleans up its associated platform resources
DeleteExternalAgent.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的纳管 Agent，并异步清理其平台关联资源

DeleteIdentityProvider.description_en: Disconnects the identity source integration of a workspace. For CustomSSO, this operation clears the shared user pool and related SAML and SCIM resources. To disable only logon or synchronization, use the corresponding API operations
DeleteIdentityProvider.description_zh: 整体断开工作空间的身份源集成。CustomSSO 会清理共享用户池及相关 SAML、SCIM 资源；只关闭登录或同步时应使用对应开关接口

DeleteIdentityProviderSCIMCredential.description_en: Revokes a specified SCIM credential. This operation does not trigger automatic creation of a new token, modify the AC synchronization switch, or disable SAML logon
DeleteIdentityProviderSCIMCredential.description_zh: 撤销指定 SCIM 凭据。不会自动创建新 Token、修改 AC 同步开关或关闭 SAML 登录

DeleteImageCache.description_en: Deletes the image cache association in a workspace and checks for agent references and instance usage before submission
DeleteImageCache.description_zh: 删除工作空间中的镜像缓存关联，提交前检查 Agent 引用和实例占用

DeleteManagedAgent.description_en: Deletes a managed Harness agent in a specified workspace and asynchronously cleans up its platform-associated resources
DeleteManagedAgent.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的托管 Harness Agent，并异步清理其平台关联资源

DeleteMcp.description_en: Deletes a specified MCP service. The deletion is an asynchronous process. After the deletion is complete, the MCP service is no longer returned
DeleteMcp.description_zh: 删除指定 MCP 服务。删除为异步过程，完成后该 MCP 服务将不再返回

DeleteMemory.description_en: Deletes a long-term memory by memory ID
DeleteMemory.description_zh: 根据 Memory ID 删除一条长期记忆

DeleteMemoryStore.description_en: Asynchronously deletes a MemoryStore and all its long-term memories
DeleteMemoryStore.description_zh: 异步删除 MemoryStore 及其中全部长期记忆

DeleteModel.description_en: Deletes a model in a specified workspace. Models that are in use cannot be deleted
DeleteModel.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的模型；正在被使用的模型不能删除

DeleteModelConnection.description_en: Submits an asynchronous deletion task for a specified model connection. The connection cannot be deleted if it has associated models or runtime references
DeleteModelConnection.description_zh: 提交指定模型连接的异步删除任务；存在关联模型或运行时引用时不能删除

DeleteSkill.description_en: Deletes a skill and its related version data from the specified workspace. The deletion operation is irreversible
DeleteSkill.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的 Skill 及其相关版本数据。删除操作不可恢复

DeleteSkillDraft.description_en: Deletes the draft version of the specified skill that is currently being edited
DeleteSkillDraft.description_zh: 删除指定 Skill 当前正在编辑的草稿版本

DeleteTeam.description_en: Deletes a team in a specified workspace. Deleting a team does not delete the users and agents within it, but only removes the membership associations
DeleteTeam.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间内的团队。删除团队不会删除其中的用户和智能体，只解除成员关系

DeleteUser.description_en: Deletes a user from a specified workspace. A user cannot be deleted if they are still a member of any team. Remove the user from the team first
DeleteUser.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间内的用户。用户仍然是任意团队的成员时不允许删除，需要先将其从团队中移除

DeleteWorkspace.description_en: Deletes a workspace that is no longer in use and ends the management lifecycle of the workspace
DeleteWorkspace.description_zh: 删除不再使用的工作空间，结束该工作空间的管理生命周期

DisableConnector.description_en: Disables the QoderCLI connector in a specified workspace. The connector can be disabled only when no agent is using it. After being disabled, the connector and its service account key configuration are removed
DisableConnector.description_zh: 停用指定工作空间中的 QoderCLI Connector。仅当没有 Agent 使用该 Connector 时可以停用；停用后移除 Connector 及其 Service Account Key 配置

DownloadAgentSpecViaOss.description_en: Retrieves the OSS presigned download URL for a specified AgentSpec to download the AgentSpec ZIP package
DownloadAgentSpecViaOss.description_zh: 获取指定 AgentSpec 的 OSS 预签名下载地址，用于下载 AgentSpec ZIP 包

DownloadSkillVersionViaOss.description_en: Retrieves the OSS pre-signed download URL for a specified skill version to download the corresponding skill ZIP package
DownloadSkillVersionViaOss.description_zh: 获取指定 Skill 版本的 OSS 预签名下载地址，用于下载对应的 Skill ZIP 包

EnableConnector.description_en: Enables the QoderCLI connector in a specified workspace. The request must provide a site, an API key, and at least one service account key. The service verifies all account keys before saving the configuration
EnableConnector.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中启用 QoderCLI Connector。请求需提供站点、API Key 和至少一个 Service Account Key；服务会先验证所有账号密钥，再保存配置

FindCustomAgentImagePreparation.description_en: Retrieves a custom image preparation task by using a submitted clientToken and queries the current progress
FindCustomAgentImagePreparation.description_zh: 使用已提交的 clientToken 找回自定义镜像准备任务并查询当前进度

ForcePublishSkillVersion.description_en: Forcibly publishes a specified skill version by bypassing the standard review process
ForcePublishSkillVersion.description_zh: 跳过常规审核流程，强制发布指定的 Skill 版本

GetAgentCodePackageDownloadUrl.description_en: Retrieves the time-limited read-only download URL for the currently saved fixed code package of a custom code or image agent
GetAgentCodePackageDownloadUrl.description_zh: 获取自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent当前已保存固定代码包的限时只读下载地址

GetAgentCodePackageOssRamAuthorizeUrl.description_en: Generates a RAM authorization link for the specified code package source bucket for the workspace resource role
GetAgentCodePackageOssRamAuthorizeUrl.description_zh: 为工作空间资源角色生成指定代码包源 Bucket 的 RAM 授权链接

GetAgentCodePackageUploadUrl.description_en: Generates a time-limited upload URL for a local code package, and returns the upload method, request headers, and the sourceUri for subsequent deployment
GetAgentCodePackageUploadUrl.description_zh: 为本地代码包生成限时上传地址，返回上传方法、请求头及后续部署使用的 sourceUri

GetAgentIMChannel.description_en: Queries the details of a specified agent IM channel
GetAgentIMChannel.description_zh: 查询指定智能体 IM 渠道的详细信息

GetAgentSpec.description_en: Queries the governance details of a specified AgentSpec, including basic information, governance pointers, and summaries of all versions
GetAgentSpec.description_zh: 查询指定 AgentSpec 的治理详情，包括基础信息、治理指针和全部版本摘要

GetAgentSpecImportFileUrl.description_en: Retrieves the OSS presigned upload URL and object name required to import an AgentSpec ZIP package. After the upload is complete, you can call the AgentSpec OSS upload API operation to complete the import
GetAgentSpecImportFileUrl.description_zh: 获取导入 AgentSpec ZIP 包所需的 OSS 预签名上传地址和对象名称。上传完成后，可调用 AgentSpec OSS 上传接口完成导入

GetAgentSpecLatest.description_en: Queries the full content of the latest version of a specified AgentSpec for editing or viewing the latest version
GetAgentSpecLatest.description_zh: 查询指定 AgentSpec 的最新版本完整内容，用于编辑或查看 latest 版本

GetAgentSpecVersion.description_en: Queries the full content of a specified AgentSpec version, including the manifest content, resource files, and metadata
GetAgentSpecVersion.description_zh: 查询指定 AgentSpec 版本的完整内容，包括 manifest 内容、资源文件和元数据

GetCredential.description_en: Queries the details of a specified credential and returns the list of agents bound to the credential. The credential content is returned in a masked format
GetCredential.description_zh: 查询指定凭证的详细信息，并返回已绑定该凭证的智能体列表。凭证内容以脱敏形式返回

GetCustomAgent.description_en: Queries the latest deployment configuration, version processing results, code package or image information, and running instance status of a custom code or image agent
GetCustomAgent.description_zh: 查询自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent的最新部署配置、版本处理结果、代码包或镜像信息及运行实例状态

GetCustomAgentImagePreparation.description_en: Queries the preparation and deployment progress of the current submission for a custom image by preparation task ID
GetCustomAgentImagePreparation.description_zh: 通过准备任务 ID 查询自定义镜像本次提交的准备与部署进度

GetExternalAgent.description_en: Queries the configuration, model source, version processing status, and external runtime status of a managed agent
GetExternalAgent.description_zh: 查询纳管 Agent的配置、模型来源、版本处理状态及外部运行状态

GetExternalAgentBootstrapOptions.description_en: Queries the available internal and public network access options for a managed agent
GetExternalAgentBootstrapOptions.description_zh: 查询纳管 Agent当前可用的内网、公网接入选项

GetIdentityProvider.description_en: Queries the binding and expected configuration of a specified identity provider. When SAML is configured for CustomSSO, this operation reads back the actual upstream SSO configuration. The SCIM status is queried through a separate API operation
GetIdentityProvider.description_zh: 查询指定身份源的绑定和期望配置。CustomSSO 已配置 SAML 时回读上游实际 SSO 配置，SCIM 状态通过独立接口查询

GetIdentityProviderSCIM.description_en: Queries the actual SCIM receiving configuration, the expected AgentCore synchronization switch, and the status of the most recent independent SCIM task. SAML configuration is not required beforehand
GetIdentityProviderSCIM.description_zh: 查询 SCIM 实际接收配置、AC 同步期望开关和最近一次独立 SCIM 任务状态。无需先配置 SAML

GetIdentityProviderServiceProvider.description_en: Queries the SAML service provider (SP) information of CustomSSO, including the Entity ID, ACS URL, and SP metadata XML, for users to configure an external IdP
GetIdentityProviderServiceProvider.description_zh: 查询 CustomSSO 的 SAML SP 信息，包括 Entity ID、ACS URL 和 SP Metadata XML，供用户配置外部 IdP

GetIdentityProviderSyncJob.description_en: Queries an identity provider synchronization task

GetIdentityProviderSyncScope.description_en: Queries the synchronization scope of an identity provider

GetImageCache.description_en: Queries the status, digest, size, and deletion conditions of an image cache in a specified workspace
GetImageCache.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间中镜像缓存的状态、摘要、大小及删除条件

GetManagedAgent.description_en: Queries the latest configuration, Harness and skill versions, configuration processing status, and running instance statistics of a managed Harness agent
GetManagedAgent.description_zh: 查询托管 Harness Agent的最新配置、Harness、技能版本、配置处理状态和运行实例统计

GetMcp.description_en: Queries the details of a specified MCP service, such as the address, type, status, authentication configuration, and protocol
GetMcp.description_zh: 查询指定 MCP 服务的地址、类型、状态、认证配置和协议等详情

GetMcpCodePackageUploadUrl.description_en: Returns a time-limited presigned upload URL and a temporary code package token. After the upload is complete, the token can be used to create or update a code deployment
GetMcpCodePackageUploadUrl.description_zh: 返回限时预签名上传地址和临时代码包令牌；上传完成后，该令牌可直接用于创建或更新代码部署

GetMcpMarketItem.description_en: Queries the details of an MCP marketplace template
GetMcpMarketItem.description_zh: 查询 MCP 市场模板详情

GetMemory.description_en: Queries a long-term memory by memory ID
GetMemory.description_zh: 根据 Memory ID 查询一条长期记忆

GetMemoryStore.description_en: Queries the public information and current status of a MemoryStore in a specified workspace
GetMemoryStore.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间中 MemoryStore 的公开信息和当前状态

GetMemoryTask.description_en: Queries the task ID returned by the asynchronous AddMemories operation
GetMemoryTask.description_zh: 查询异步 AddMemories 返回的 taskId

GetModel.description_en: Queries the detailed configuration and region of a model in a specified workspace
GetModel.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间中模型的详细配置和所属地域

GetModelConnection.description_en: Queries the detailed configuration, credential configuration status, publish status, and region of a specified model connection
GetModelConnection.description_zh: 查询指定模型连接的详细配置、凭据配置状态、发布状态和所属地域

GetServiceEndpoint.description_en: Queries the details of a specified service endpoint, including the target route, access addresses, authentication configuration, and current status
GetServiceEndpoint.description_zh: 查询指定服务端点的详细信息，包括目标路由、访问地址、鉴权配置和当前状态

GetServiceEndpointApiKey.description_en: Queries the active API key and its invocation method for a service endpoint in a specified workspace
GetServiceEndpointApiKey.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间内服务端点当前生效的 API Key 及其调用方式

GetSkillDetail.description_en: Queries the basic information, version status, tags, visibility scope, and version list of a specified skill
GetSkillDetail.description_zh: 查询指定 Skill 的基础信息、版本状态、标签、可见范围和版本列表

GetSkillImportFileUrl.description_en: Retrieves the Object Storage Service (OSS) presigned upload URL and object name required to import a skill ZIP package. After the upload is complete, you can call the skill OSS upload API operation to complete the import
GetSkillImportFileUrl.description_zh: 获取导入 Skill ZIP 包所需的 OSS 预签名上传地址和对象名称。上传完成后，可调用 Skill OSS 上传接口完成导入

GetSkillVersionDetail.description_en: Queries the complete details of a specified skill version, including version metadata, skill content, and associated resources
GetSkillVersionDetail.description_zh: 查询指定 Skill 版本的完整详情，包括版本元数据、Skill 内容和关联资源

GetTeam.description_en: Queries the details of a specified team, including the complete attributes and team roles of each user and agent member in the team
GetTeam.description_zh: 查询指定团队的详细信息，响应中同时返回团队内每个用户成员和智能体成员的完整属性及其团队角色

GetUser.description_en: Queries the details of a specific user in a specified workspace. Returns an error if the user does not exist
GetUser.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间内某个用户的详细信息。用户不存在时返回错误

GetWorkspace.description_en: Queries the details of a workspace by workspace ID, including the lifecycle status, CMS workspace, AI registry namespace, and current network policies
GetWorkspace.description_zh: 根据工作空间 ID 查询工作空间详情，包括生命周期状态、CMS Workspace、AIRegistry Namespace 和当前网络策略

GetWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorizeUrl.description_en: Generates a RAM authorization link for the workspace resource role to pull images from a specified ACR Enterprise Edition repository
GetWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorizeUrl.description_zh: 生成工作空间资源角色对指定 ACR 企业版仓库的 RAM 拉取授权链接

GetWorkspaceAgenticFsMountRamAuthorizeUr.description_en: Retrieves the RAM authorization page URL to grant the workspace resource role access to a specified AgenticFS access point before configuring NAS storage mounting for an agent
GetWorkspaceAgenticFsMountRamAuthorizeUr.description_zh: 为 Agent 配置 NAS 存储挂载前，获取授权工作空间资源角色访问指定 AgenticFS 接入点的 RAM 页面地址

GetWorkspacePlugin.description_en: Queries the activation status and configuration of a specified component in a workspace. The collaboration value corresponds to the Collaboration component displayed in the console
GetWorkspacePlugin.description_zh: 查询工作空间指定组件的开通状态和配置；collaboration 对应控制台展示的“协作组件”

InstallMcpMarketItem.description_zh: 安装 MCP 市场模板

InstallWorkspacePlugin.description_en: Enables a component for a workspace. This operation corresponds to enabling the collaboration component in the console. After the component is enabled, you can query the component status and current configurations
InstallWorkspacePlugin.description_zh: 为工作空间开通组件，对应控制台的协作组件开通操作；开通后可查询组件状态和当前配置

ListAgentCodeRuntimes.description_en: Queries the identity, name, and architecture of language runtime environments currently available for code package deployment by page
ListAgentCodeRuntimes.description_zh: 分页查询当前可用于代码包部署的语言运行环境标识、名称和架构

ListAgentIMChannels.description_en: Queries the IM channels for a specified agent
ListAgentIMChannels.description_zh: 查询指定智能体的 IM 渠道列表

ListAgentSpecs.description_en: Performs a paging query of AgentSpecs in a specified workspace, and supports name search, sorting, and filtering by owner, visibility scope, and business labels
ListAgentSpecs.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 AgentSpec，支持名称搜索、排序以及按所有者、可见范围和业务标签筛选

ListAgentTeams.description_en: Queries the teams to which specified agents belong. Specify the agent IDs to query by using agentIds. The response includes the membership information of each agent in its teams, such as the team ID, team name, and the role of the agent in the team
ListAgentTeams.description_zh: 查询指定智能体所属的团队列表。通过 agentIds 指定需要查询的智能体 ID，返回每个智能体与团队的成员关系信息，包括团队 ID、团队名称和智能体在团队中承担的角色

ListConnectorModels.description_en: Queries the official and enterprise models available for the enabled QoderCLI connector. The service retrieves models in real time by using the saved API key and organization ID, and deduplicates them by model ID
ListConnectorModels.description_zh: 查询已启用 QoderCLI Connector 可用的官方模型和企业模型。服务使用已保存的 API Key 和组织 ID 实时获取模型，并按模型 ID 去重

ListConnectors.description_en: Queries the list of connectors supported by a specified workspace, along with their status, the number of bound agents, and configurations. The current version returns the QoderCLI connector
ListConnectors.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间支持的 Connector 列表及其状态、已绑定 Agent 数量和配置。当前版本返回 QoderCLI Connector

ListCredentials.description_en: Performs a paged query for credentials in a specified workspace. Filters credentials by type by using credentialType, performs fuzzy filtering by credential name by using nameLike, specifies the maximum number of records per page for paging by using maxResults, and retrieves the next page by using nextToken. If maxResults is not specified, the server returns 10 records by default
ListCredentials.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的凭证。通过 credentialType 按类型过滤，通过 nameLike 按凭证名称模糊过滤，通过 maxResults 指定单页最大记录数，通过 nextToken 获取下一页。未指定 maxResults 时服务端默认返回 10 条

ListCustomAgents.description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the identity, deployment method, and status summary of custom code or image agents in a workspace, with paging support
ListCustomAgents.description_zh: 分页查询工作空间内自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent的标识、部署方式和状态摘要

ListExternalAgents.description_en: Performs a paging query to retrieve the identity, configuration versions, and status summary of managed agents in a workspace
ListExternalAgents.description_zh: 分页查询工作空间内纳管 Agent的标识、配置版本和状态摘要

ListIdentityProviderDepartments.description_en: Queries the departments of an identity provider by paging

ListIdentityProviderSCIMCredentials.description_en: Queries the complete summary list of up to two SCIM credentials in a shared user pool, without returning plaintext tokens or supporting pagination
ListIdentityProviderSCIMCredentials.description_zh: 查询共享用户池中最多两枚 SCIM 凭据的完整摘要列表，不返回 Token 明文，不提供分页

ListIdentityProviders.description_en: Queries the summary of existing identity provider bindings for a workspace, including CustomSSO. Returns local binding information without querying the actual upstream SAML or SCIM configurations
ListIdentityProviders.description_zh: 查询工作空间已有的身份源绑定摘要，包括 CustomSSO。返回本地绑定信息，不回查上游 SAML 或 SCIM 实际配置

ListImageCaches.description_en: Performs a paged query for image caches in a workspace. Supports paging and filtering by image source and cache status
ListImageCaches.description_zh: 分页查询工作空间的镜像缓存，支持按镜像来源和缓存状态筛选

ListManagedAgents.description_en: Performs a paging query for the identity, harnesses, configuration versions, and status summary of managed Harness agents in a workspace
ListManagedAgents.description_zh: 分页查询工作空间内托管 Harness Agent的标识、Harness、配置版本和状态摘要

ListMcpMarketItems.description_zh: 查询 MCP 市场模板

ListMcpTools.description_en: Queries the list of tools exposed by a specified MCP service and their input and output schemas
ListMcpTools.description_zh: 查询指定 MCP 服务公开的工具列表及其输入输出 Schema

ListMcps.description_en: Performs a paging query for MCP services and their configurations and status in a specified workspace
ListMcps.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 MCP 服务及其配置和状态

ListMemories.description_en: Queries long-term memory with paging and supports independent filtering by UserId, AgentId, and SessionId
ListMemories.description_zh: 分页查询长期记忆，可独立按 UserId、AgentId 和 SessionId 过滤；

ListMemorySessionMessages.description_en: Queries raw messages by exact scope with paging. SessionId is required, and at least one of UserId and AgentId must be provided
ListMemorySessionMessages.description_zh: 按精确 Scope 分页查询原始消息。SessionId 必填，UserId 和 AgentId 至少提供一个

ListMemorySessions.description_en: Performs a paged query for sessions in a MemoryStore, supporting paging and filtering by user ID and agent ID independently
ListMemorySessions.description_zh: 分页查询 MemoryStore 中的 Session，可独立按 UserId 和 AgentId 过滤

ListMemoryStores.description_en: Performs a paged query of MemoryStores in a specified workspace by using paging
ListMemoryStores.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 MemoryStore

ListModelConnections.description_en: Queries model connections in a specified workspace by using paging. Supports filtering by name, provider type, and invocation protocol
ListModelConnections.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的模型连接，支持按名称、供应商类型和调用协议筛选

ListModels.description_en: Performs a paging query for models in a specified workspace and supports filtering by model connection and model name
ListModels.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的模型，支持按模型连接和模型名称筛选

ListPredefinedModelProviders.description_en: Queries the providers supported by the built-in model catalog of AgentCore and their default service configurations
ListPredefinedModelProviders.description_zh: 查询 AgentCore 内置模型目录支持的供应商及其默认服务配置

ListPredefinedModels.description_en: Queries the models and their capabilities for a specified provider in the AgentCore built-in model catalog
ListPredefinedModels.description_zh: 查询指定供应商在 AgentCore 内置模型目录中的模型及其能力信息

ListSandboxSessions.description_en: Performs a paged query for the current active sessions and their sources in a specified agent instance, supporting paging
ListSandboxSessions.description_zh: 分页查询指定智能体实例中的当前活动会话及其来源

ListSandboxes.description_en: Performs a paging query on the running instances of an agent, and supports filtering by Sandbox ID and current valid session ID fragments
ListSandboxes.description_zh: 分页查询智能体的运行实例，支持按 Sandbox ID 和当前有效 Session ID 片段筛选

ListServiceEndpoints.description_en: Queries service endpoints in a specified workspace with paging, and supports filtering by target type, agent, collaboration component, and status
ListServiceEndpoints.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的服务端点，支持按目标类型、智能体、协作组件和状态过滤

ListSkillReferences.description_en: Queries the reference relationships of a skill
ListSkillReferences.description_zh: 查询 Skill 引用关系

ListSkills.description_en: Performs a paged query of skills in a specified workspace and returns the basic information, version status, and paging information of the skills
ListSkills.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 Skill，返回 Skill 基础信息、版本状态和分页信息

ListTeams.description_en: Performs a paging query of teams in a specified workspace. You can use nameLike to filter teams by fuzzy match on the team name, maxResults to specify the maximum number of records per page, and nextToken to retrieve the next page. If maxResults is not specified, the server returns 10 records by default. The member information in the list includes only the member ID, name, and team role
ListTeams.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的团队。通过 nameLike 按团队名称模糊过滤，通过 maxResults 指定单页最大记录数，通过 nextToken 获取下一页。未指定 maxResults 时服务端默认返回 10 条。列表中的成员信息只包含成员标识、名称和团队角色

ListUsers.description_en: Performs a paged query for users in a specified workspace. You can filter users by fuzzy match on the username by using nameLike, specify the maximum number of records per paging by using maxResults, and retrieve the next paging by using nextToken. If maxResults is not specified, the server returns 10 records by default
ListUsers.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的用户。通过 nameLike 按用户名称模糊过滤，通过 maxResults 指定单页最大记录数，通过 nextToken 获取下一页。未指定 maxResults 时服务端默认返回 10 条

ListWorkspaces.description_en: Performs a paged query of workspaces under the current tenant. By default, the list does not return soft-deleted records whose status is Deleted. The server applies stable sorting to the results in chronological order of creation during paging
ListWorkspaces.description_zh: 分页查询当前租户下的工作空间。列表默认不返回状态为 Deleted 的软删除记录，结果按创建顺序由服务端稳定排序

OfflineSkill.description_en: Takes the online version of a specified skill offline so that it is no longer used as the online version
OfflineSkill.description_zh: 将指定 Skill 的在线版本下线，使其不再作为在线版本使用

OnlineSkill.description_en: Sets the specified skill version as the online version
OnlineSkill.description_zh: 将指定 Skill 版本设置为在线版本

PrecheckSkillUploadViaOss.description_en: Parses and checks one or more skill ZIP packages uploaded to OSS, and returns the names, versions, and conflict check results
PrecheckSkillUploadViaOss.description_zh: 解析并检查已上传到 OSS 的一个或多个 Skill ZIP 包，返回名称、版本和冲突检查结果

PrepareIdentityProviderSCIM.description_en: Prepares the SCIM receiving configuration and returns the provisioning URL and credential summary. Issues a token if no available credentials exist and returns the plaintext only in this response, without automatically enabling AgentCore user synchronization
PrepareIdentityProviderSCIM.description_zh: 准备 SCIM 接收配置，返回预配 URL 和凭据摘要；没有可用凭据时签发 Token，仅本次返回明文，不自动开启 AC 用户同步

PublishSkillVersion.description_en: Publishes a specified skill version and changes its status to published
PublishSkillVersion.description_zh: 发布指定的 Skill 版本，使其进入已发布状态

RedraftSkillVersion.description_en: Reverts a specified skill version to an editable draft for further modification
RedraftSkillVersion.description_zh: 将指定 Skill 版本重新转为可编辑草稿，以便继续修改

ResetUserPassword.description_en: Resets the logon password of a specified user. Specify the user by using agentCoreUserId or username. You must specify at least one of them. This operation only supports resetting the passwords of users who use local password authentication for the workspace. If you do not specify the password parameter, the server generates a random password and returns it in the response
ResetUserPassword.description_zh: 重置指定用户的登录密码。通过 agentCoreUserId 或 username 指定用户，两者至少指定一个。仅支持重置使用工作空间本地密码认证的用户；不指定 password 时由服务端生成随机密码并在响应中返回

RetryImageCache.description_en: Resubmits the creation request for an ACR image cache in a specified workspace
RetryImageCache.description_zh: 重新提交指定工作空间中 ACR 镜像缓存的制作请求

SearchMemories.description_en: Retrieves long-term memory from MemoryStore based on semantics
SearchMemories.description_zh: 根据语义查询检索 MemoryStore 中的长期记忆

SubmitAgentSpecVersion.description_en: Submits a specified draft version of an AgentSpec for review. If no release pipeline is configured, the version is directly published online
SubmitAgentSpecVersion.description_zh: 提交指定 AgentSpec 草稿版本进入审核流程。未配置发布流水线时，版本将直接发布为在线状态

SubmitSkillVersion.description_en: Submits a specified draft version of a skill for review
SubmitSkillVersion.description_zh: 提交指定的 Skill 草稿版本进入审核流程

UpdateAgentIMChannel.description_en: Updates the ServiceEndpoint, enablement status, or channel behavior configuration bound to an IM channel. At least one updatable field must be provided
UpdateAgentIMChannel.description_zh: 更新 IM 渠道绑定的 ServiceEndpoint、启停状态或渠道行为配置。至少需要提供一个可更新字段

UpdateAgentIMChannelCredential.description_en: Fully updates the channel credentials for a specified IM channel. Secrets are not returned in the response
UpdateAgentIMChannelCredential.description_zh: 全量更新指定 IM 渠道的渠道凭据。Secret 不会在响应中回显

UpdateAgentSpec.description_en: Updates the business tags, version tags, and visibility scope of a specified AgentSpec. Fields not provided remain unchanged
UpdateAgentSpec.description_zh: 更新指定 AgentSpec 的业务标签、版本标签和可见范围；未传入的字段保持不变

UpdateConnector.description_en: Updates the API key or service account key collection for an enabled QoderCLI connector. When serviceAccountKeys is submitted, the service uses it as the complete updated key collection to add, rename, rotate, and delete keys
UpdateConnector.description_zh: 更新已启用 QoderCLI Connector 的 API Key 或 Service Account Key 集合。提交 serviceAccountKeys 时，服务将其作为更新后的完整密钥集合执行新增、重命名、轮换和删除

UpdateCredential.description_en: Updates the content, description, or MCP header application scope of a specified credential. Unspecified configurations retain their original values. The credential name and type cannot be modified
UpdateCredential.description_zh: 更新指定凭证的内容、描述或 MCP Header 适用范围。未指定的配置保留原值，凭证名称和类型不可修改

UpdateCustomAgent.description_en: Updates the configuration of a custom code or image agent in a specified workspace and executes the update asynchronously. Omitted top-level fields retain their original configurations. You can call GetCustomAgent to query the update result
UpdateCustomAgent.description_zh: 更新指定工作空间中的自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent配置，并异步执行更新。省略的顶层字段保留原配置，可通过 GetCustomAgent 查询更新结果

UpdateExternalAgent.description_en: Updates the model source, instructions, tools, and skills of a managed agent, and processes the configuration asynchronously
UpdateExternalAgent.description_zh: 更新纳管 Agent的模型来源、指令、工具和技能，并异步处理配置

UpdateIdentityProvider.description_en: Modifies the logon configuration of a bound identity provider in a specified workspace. DingTalk and Feishu support the logon switch, incremental synchronization switch, application configuration, and synchronization scope. CustomSSO supports SAML configuration and the logon switch. Updates take effect asynchronously. Call GetIdentityProvider to query the status
UpdateIdentityProvider.description_zh: 修改指定工作空间已绑定身份源的登录配置。DingTalk、Feishu 支持登录开关、增量同步开关、应用配置和同步范围；CustomSSO 支持 SAML 配置和登录开关。实际更新异步生效，请通过 GetIdentityProvider 查询状态

UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM.description_en: Enables or disables SCIM user synchronization independently. When enabled, an initial full import is executed asynchronously, and the result can be queried by calling GetIdentityProviderSCIM. The SAML logon configuration is retained
UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM.description_zh: 独立启用或关闭 SCIM 用户同步。开启时异步执行首次全量导入，结果通过 GetIdentityProviderSCIM 查询，保留 SAML 登录配置

UpdateManagedAgent.description_en: Updates the model, instructions, skills, and runtime configuration of a managed Harness agent and executes the update asynchronously. Omitted top-level fields retain their original configuration
UpdateManagedAgent.description_zh: 更新托管 Harness Agent的模型、指令、技能和运行配置，并异步执行更新；省略的顶层字段保留原配置

UpdateMcp.description_en: Updates the address, description, authentication, or Swagger configuration of a specified MCP service. The MCP type and protocol cannot be modified after creation. The update process is asynchronous
UpdateMcp.description_zh: 更新指定 MCP 服务的地址、描述、认证或 Swagger 配置。MCP 类型和协议在创建后不可修改。更新为异步过程

UpdateMcpTemplateConfig.description_en: Updates MCP parameters based on a template
UpdateMcpTemplateConfig.description_zh: 按模板更新 MCP 参数

UpdateMemory.description_en: Updates the long-term memory text or metadata based on the memory ID
UpdateMemory.description_zh: 根据 Memory ID 更新长期记忆文本或元数据

UpdateModel.description_en: Updates the description, context token limit, maximum output token count, or capability configuration of a specified model
UpdateModel.description_zh: 更新指定模型的描述、上下文 Token 上限、最大输出 Token 数或能力配置

UpdateModelConnection.description_en: Updates the mutable configurations of a specified model connection and resubmits the publishing task. The invocation protocol cannot be modified after creation
UpdateModelConnection.description_zh: 更新指定模型连接的可变配置并重新提交发布任务；调用协议创建后不可修改

UpdateSkillBizTags.description_en: Updates the business tags of a specified skill. Other attributes that are not specified remain unchanged
UpdateSkillBizTags.description_zh: 更新指定 Skill 的业务标签；未传入的其他属性保持不变

UpdateSkillLabels.description_en: Updates the version labels and their mappings for a specified skill
UpdateSkillLabels.description_zh: 更新指定 Skill 的版本标签及其指向关系

UpdateSkillScope.description_en: Updates the visibility scope of a specified skill
UpdateSkillScope.description_zh: 更新指定 Skill 的可见范围

UpdateTeam.description_en: Updates the description and members of a specified team. When users or agents are provided, the corresponding member lists are replaced based on full overwrite semantics. Member lists that are not provided remain unchanged. The team name cannot be modified after creation
UpdateTeam.description_zh: 更新指定团队的描述和成员。传入 users 或 agents 时按全量覆盖语义替换对应的成员列表，未传入的成员列表保持不变。团队名称创建后不可修改

UpdateUser.description_en: Updates the display name, email address, or note of a specified user. At least one of displayName, email, and note must be specified. Unspecified properties remain unchanged. The username cannot be modified after creation
UpdateUser.description_zh: 更新指定用户的显示名称、邮箱或备注。displayName、email 和 note 至少指定一个，未指定的属性保持不变。用户名称创建后不可修改

UpdateWorkspace.description_en: Updates the name or network configuration of a workspace. Only workspaces in the Initialized state can be updated. Status, TenantId, and RegionId are maintained by the server and cannot be modified through this operation
UpdateWorkspace.description_zh: 更新工作空间名称或网络配置。只有状态为 Initialized 的工作空间允许更新。Status、TenantId 和 RegionId 由服务端维护，不允许通过本接口修改

UploadAgentSpecViaOss.description_en: Retrieves an uploaded AgentSpec ZIP package from OSS, parses the package, and imports the AgentSpec into the current workspace
UploadAgentSpecViaOss.description_zh: 从 OSS 获取已上传的 AgentSpec ZIP 包，解析后将 AgentSpec 导入当前工作空间

UploadSkillViaOss.description_en: Imports a skill into the current workspace by retrieving and parsing an uploaded skill ZIP package from OSS
UploadSkillViaOss.description_zh: 从 OSS 获取已上传的 Skill ZIP 包，解析后将 Skill 导入当前工作空间

ValidateAgentCodePackageFromOss.description_en: Validates the read conditions of the workspace role for a specified OSS code package object and returns the source URI and package information
ValidateAgentCodePackageFromOss.description_zh: 校验工作空间角色对指定 OSS 代码包对象的读取条件，并返回来源地址和包信息

VerifyAgentCodePackageOssRamAuthorizatio.description_en: Queries the binding status of the authorization policy for the code package source bucket to the current workspace resource role
VerifyAgentCodePackageOssRamAuthorizatio.description_zh: 查询代码包源 Bucket 对当前工作空间资源角色的授权策略绑定状态

VerifyConnector.description_en: Verifies whether one or more Qoder service account keys are available at a specified site. This operation does not save the keys or modify the connector status
VerifyConnector.description_zh: 验证一个或多个 Qoder Service Account Key 在指定站点是否可用。该操作不保存密钥，也不修改 Connector 状态

VerifyWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorization.description_en: Queries the authorization status of a workspace resource role for a specified ACR Enterprise Edition repository
VerifyWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorization.description_zh: 查询工作空间资源角色对指定 ACR 企业版仓库的授权状态

VerifyWorkspaceAgenticFsMountRamAuthoriz.description_en: Queries whether the workspace resource role has been granted access to the specified NAS (AgenticFS) access point for subsequent Agent mount configurations
VerifyWorkspaceAgenticFsMountRamAuthoriz.description_zh: 查询工作空间资源角色是否已完成目标 NAS（AgenticFS）接入点的访问授权，供继续配置 Agent 挂载时使用

VerifyWorkspaceOssMountRamAuthorization.description_en: Verifies the OSS mount authorization for a workspace, or checks and updates the authorization status of the default OSS storage for the workspace
VerifyWorkspaceOssMountRamAuthorization.description_zh: 验证工作空间 OSS 挂载授权，或检查并更新工作空间默认 OSS 存储的授权状态
